),\\n    weeks_with_season AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        w.*,\\n        sm.season_code\\n      FROM weeks w\\n      LEFT JOIN `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.season_master` sm\\n        ON\\n          w.fiscal_week_begin_date\\n          BETWEEN sm.season_start_date\\n          AND sm.season_end_date\\n      QUALIFY\\n        ROW_NUMBER()\\n          OVER (\\n            PARTITION BY w.fiscal_year_week\\n            ORDER BY sm.season_code DESC\\n          )\\n        = 1\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 2) Deduped store master\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    deduped_store_master AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        s1_name,\\n        s2_name,\\n        MAX(channel) AS channel\\n      FROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.store_master`\\n      GROUP BY 1, 2\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 3) op_master_enriched (ORIGINAL channel logic)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    op_master_enriched AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        om.fiscal_year_week,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN\\n            om.s1_name = 'WHOLESALE FULL PRICE'\\n            AND om.s2_name IN (\\n              'SPECIALTY OTHER',\\n              'GRAFTON APPAREL__ia_char_30 LTD',\\n              'ZAPPOS.COM LLC')\\n            THEN 'WSFP - SSOTHER'\\n          ELSE sm.channel\\n          END AS channel,\\n        om.l1_name,\\n        om.l2_name,\\n        om.l3_name,\\n        om.kpi1 AS target_units,  -- sales qty\\n        om.kpi2 AS target_revenue,\\n        om.kpi1 * om.kpi5 AS target_cost,\\n        om.kpi16 AS ty_units,  -- receipts\\n        om.kpi18 AS ty_cost,\\n        om.kpi17 AS ty_msrp,\\n        om.kpi11 AS bop_units,\\n        om.kpi12 AS bop_dollars\\n      FROM `{project_id}.{dataset_id}.op_master` om\\n      LEFT JOIN deduped_store_master sm\\n        ON\\n          sm.s1_name = om.s1_name\\n          AND sm.s2_name = om.s2_name\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 4) SALES at final grain (DTG STORE / WEB)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    sales_base AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        ome.l1_name,\\n        ome.l2_name,\\n        ome.l3_name,\\n        ome.channel,\\n        w.fiscal_year,\\n        w.fiscal_month,\\n        w.fiscal_week,\\n        w.season_code,\\n        CAST(SUM(ome.target_units) AS INT64) AS target_units,\\n        SUM(ome.target_revenue) AS target_revenue,\\n        SUM(ome.target_cost) AS target_cost\\n      FROM op_master_enriched ome\\n      JOIN weeks_with_season w\\n        ON ome.fiscal_year_week = w.fiscal_year_week\\n      WHERE\\n        ome.channel IN (\\n          'DTG - STORE', 'DTG - WEB', 'OUT - OUT', 'WSFP - SSOTHER')\\n      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 5) DTG sales qty ratio (STORE vs WEB)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    dtg_sales_ratio AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        l1_name,\\n        l2_name,\\n        l3_name,\\n        fiscal_year,\\n        fiscal_month,\\n        fiscal_week,\\n        season_code,\\n        SAFE_DIVIDE(\\n          SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'DTG - STORE' THEN target_units END),\\n          SUM(\\n            CASE\\n              WHEN channel IN ('DTG - STORE', 'DTG - WEB') THEN target_units\\n              END)) AS store_ratio\\n      FROM sales_base\\n      WHERE channel IN ('DTG - STORE', 'DTG - WEB')\\n      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 6) DTG-DUMMY receipts (UNSPLIT)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    dtg_dummy_receipts AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        ome.l1_name,\\n        ome.l2_name,\\n        ome.l3_name,\\n        w.fiscal_year,\\n        w.fiscal_month,\\n        w.fiscal_week,\\n        w.season_code,\\n        SUM(ome.ty_units) AS ty_units,\\n        SUM(ome.ty_cost) AS ty_cost,\\n        SUM(ome.ty_msrp) AS ty_msrp,\\n        SUM(ome.bop_units) AS bop_units,\\n        SUM(ome.bop_dollars) AS bop_dollars\\n      FROM op_master_enriched ome\\n      JOIN weeks_with_season w\\n        ON ome.fiscal_year_week = w.fiscal_year_week\\n      WHERE ome.channel = 'DTG - DUMMY'\\n      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 7) SPLIT DTG-DUMMY → STORE / WEB (NO OFFSET YET)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    dtg_split_receipts AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        r.l1_name,\\n        r.l2_name,\\n        r.l3_name,\\n        ch AS channel,\\n        r.fiscal_year,\\n        r.fiscal_month,\\n        r.fiscal_week,\\n        r.season_code,\\n        r.ty_units * COALESCE(\\n          CASE\\n            WHEN ch = 'DTG - STORE'\\n              THEN d.store_ratio\\n            ELSE 1 - d.store_ratio\\n            END,\\n          0.5) AS ty_units,\\n        r.ty_cost * COALESCE(\\n          CASE\\n            WHEN ch = 'DTG - STORE'\\n              THEN d.store_ratio\\n            ELSE 1 - d.store_ratio\\n            END,\\n          0.5) AS ty_cost,\\n        r.ty_msrp * COALESCE(\\n          CASE\\n            WHEN ch = 'DTG - STORE'\\n              THEN d.store_ratio\\n            ELSE 1 - d.store_ratio\\n            END,\\n          0.5) AS ty_msrp,\\n        r.bop_units * COALESCE(\\n          CASE\\n            WHEN ch = 'DTG - STORE'\\n              THEN d.store_ratio\\n            ELSE 1 - d.store_ratio\\n            END,\\n          0.5) AS bop_units,\\n        r.bop_dollars * COALESCE(\\n          CASE\\n            WHEN ch = 'DTG - STORE'\\n              THEN d.store_ratio\\n            ELSE 1 - d.store_ratio\\n            END,\\n          0.5) AS bop_dollars\\n      FROM dtg_dummy_receipts r\\n      LEFT JOIN dtg_sales_ratio d\\n        USING (\\n          l1_name,\\n          l2_name,\\n          l3_name,\\n          fiscal_year,\\n          fiscal_month,\\n          fiscal_week,\\n          season_code)\\n      CROSS JOIN UNNEST(['DTG - STORE', 'DTG - WEB']) AS ch\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 8) APPLY OFFSET (1 month back) ON SPLIT RECEIPTS\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    offset_map AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        s.*,\\n        w.fiscal_week_begin_date,\\n        DATE_SUB(w.fiscal_week_begin_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS offset_date\\n      FROM dtg_split_receipts s\\n      JOIN weeks_with_season w\\n        ON\\n          s.fiscal_year = w.fiscal_year\\n          AND s.fiscal_week = w.fiscal_week\\n    ),\\n    offset_receipts AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        o.l1_name,\\n        o.l2_name,\\n        o.l3_name,\\n        o.channel,\\n        o.fiscal_year,\\n        o.fiscal_month,\\n        o.fiscal_week,\\n        o.season_code,\\n        COALESCE(p.ty_units, 0) AS ty_rcpt_units,\\n        COALESCE(p.ty_cost, 0) AS ty_rcpt_cost,\\n        COALESCE(p.ty_msrp, 0) AS ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n        COALESCE(p.bop_units, 0) AS bop_units,\\n        COALESCE(p.bop_dollars, 0) AS bop_dollars\\n      FROM offset_map o\\n      LEFT JOIN weeks_with_season w2\\n        ON\\n          o.offset_date\\n          BETWEEN w2.fiscal_week_begin_date\\n          AND w2.fiscal_week_end_date\\n      LEFT JOIN dtg_split_receipts p\\n        ON\\n          p.l1_name = o.l1_name\\n          AND p.l2_name = o.l2_name\\n          AND p.l3_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.l3_name\\n          AND p.channel = o.channel\\n          AND p.fiscal_year = w2.fiscal_year\\n          AND p.fiscal_week = w2.fiscal_week\\n    ),\\n\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    -- 9) FINAL SOURCE (DTG offset + OUT/WSFP current)\\n    --------------------------------------------------------------------\\n    final_src AS (\\n      SELECT\\n        s.l1_name,\\n        s.l2_name,\\n        s.l3_name,\\n        s.channel,\\n        s.fiscal_year,\\n        s.fiscal_month,\\n        s.fiscal_week,\\n        s.season_code,\\n        s.target_units,\\n        s.target_revenue,\\n        s.target_cost,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN s.channel LIKE 'DTG%' THEN o.ty_rcpt_units\\n          ELSE c.ty_units\\n          END AS ty_rcpt_units,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN s.channel LIKE 'DTG%' THEN o.ty_rcpt_cost\\n          ELSE c.ty_cost\\n          END AS ty_rcpt_cost,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN s.channel LIKE 'DTG%' THEN o.ty_rcpt_msrp\\n          ELSE c.ty_msrp\\n          END AS ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN s.channel LIKE 'DTG%' THEN o.bop_units\\n          ELSE c.bop_units\\n          END AS bop_units,\\n        CASE\\n          WHEN s.channel LIKE 'DTG%' THEN o.bop_dollars\\n          ELSE c.bop_dollars\\n          END AS bop_dollars\\n      FROM sales_base s\\n      LEFT JOIN offset_receipts o\\n        USING (\\n          l1_name,\\n          l2_name,\\n          l3_name,\\n          channel,\\n          fiscal_year,\\n          fiscal_month,\\n          fiscal_week,\\n          season_code)\\n      LEFT JOIN\\n        (\\n          SELECT\\n            ome.l1_name,\\n            ome.l2_name,\\n            ome.l3_name,\\n            ome.channel,\\n            w.fiscal_year,\\n            w.fiscal_month,\\n            w.fiscal_week,\\n            w.season_code,\\n            SUM(ome.ty_units) AS ty_units,\\n            SUM(ome.ty_cost) AS ty_cost,\\n            SUM(ome.ty_msrp) AS ty_msrp,\\n            SUM(ome.bop_units) AS bop_units,\\n            SUM(ome.bop_dollars) AS bop_dollars\\n          FROM op_master_enriched ome\\n          JOIN weeks_with_season w\\n            ON ome.fiscal_year_week = w.fiscal_year_week\\n          WHERE ome.channel IN ('OUT - OUT', 'WSFP - SSOTHER')\\n          GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8\\n        ) c\\n        USING (\\n          l1_name,\\n          l2_name,\\n          l3_name,\\n          channel,\\n          fiscal_year,\\n          fiscal_month,\\n          fiscal_week,\\n          season_code)\\n    )\\n  SELECT * FROM final_src\\n) src\\n\\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\\n-- MERGE KEY\\n--------------------------------------------------------------------\\nON\\n  tgt.l1_name = src.l1_name\\n  AND tgt.l2_name = src.l2_name\\n  AND tgt.l3_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM src.l3_name\\n  AND tgt.channel = src.channel\\n  AND tgt.fiscal_year = src.fiscal_year\\n  AND tgt.fiscal_month = src.fiscal_month\\n  AND tgt.fiscal_week = src.fiscal_week\\n  AND tgt.season_code\\n    = src.season_code\\n      WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE\\nSET\\n  target_units = src.target_units,\\n  target_revenue = src.target_revenue,\\n  target_cost = src.target_cost,\\n  ty_rcpt_units = src.ty_rcpt_units,\\n  ty_rcpt_cost = src.ty_rcpt_cost,\\n  ty_rcpt_msrp = src.ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n  bop_units = src.bop_units,\\n  bop_dollars = src.bop_dollars,\\n  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),\\n  is_updated = TRUE\\n    WHEN NOT MATCHED\\n      THEN\\n        INSERT(\\n          l1_name,\\n          l2_name,\\n          l3_name,\\n          channel,\\n          fiscal_year,\\n          fiscal_month,\\n          fiscal_week,\\n          season_code,\\n          target_units,\\n          target_revenue,\\n          target_cost,\\n          ty_rcpt_units,\\n          ty_rcpt_cost,\\n          ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n          bop_units,\\n          bop_dollars,\\n          created_at,\\n          updated_at,\\n          is_updated)\\n          VALUES(\\n            src.l1_name,\\n            src.l2_name,\\n            src.l3_name,\\n            src.channel,\\n            src.fiscal_year,\\n            src.fiscal_month,\\n            src.fiscal_week,\\n            src.season_code,\\n            src.target_units,\\n            src.target_revenue,\\n            src.target_cost,\\n            src.ty_rcpt_units,\\n            src.ty_rcpt_cost,\\n            src.ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n            src.bop_units,\\n            src.bop_dollars,\\n            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),\\n            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),\\n            TRUE);\\n\\nSELECT \\n    l1_name,\\n    l2_name,\\n    l3_name,\\n    channel,\\n    sub_channel,\\n    store_type,\\n    fiscal_year,\\n    fiscal_month,\\n    fiscal_week,\\n    season_code,\\n    target_units,\\n    target_revenue,\\n    target_cost,\\n    ty_rcpt_units,\\n    ty_rcpt_cost,\\n    ty_rcpt_msrp,\\n    bop_units,\\n    bop_dollars,\\n    created_at,\\n    updated_at,\\n    is_updated\\nFROM {project_id}.{dataset_id}.ty_receipts WHERE is_updated = TRUE;"}
